scope: N1000 practical finite-window throughput; old stress values are observations, not truth targets. No automatic steady state or parameter-convergence claim.
timing_basis: Elapsed wall-clock profile sums, not CPU-seconds; final prepared lookahead excluded. Process wall includes startup, lookahead and unfinished work.
observable_basis: Duration-weighted statistics of recorded macro-interval means. Std is temporal variability, not uncertainty of the mean; no independent-sample assumption.
contact_work_basis: contact_power is signed total contact work, including elastic storage; it is NOT pure dissipation. Rolling projection/plastic work is separately recorded. True total contact plastic dissipation is unavailable unless sliding, rolling and twisting channels are all recorded.
surface_dg_diagnostic_basis: surface_quadrature_evaluations sums returned callback evaluation counts, including rejected trial callbacks but not incomplete calls that throw. Maximum quadrature defect/panels include returned trials. Surface potential change plus path work is a numerical pair-path work balance, distinct from algebraic diag13.
rejected_work_basis: Rejected attempt counts and their contribution to total solver counters are recorded; rejected-only runtime is not separately measured.
comparison_basis: Same dt, fixture and physical coefficients required; compare common achieved prefix if a timeout occurs. Cost ratios are not accuracy-qualified speedups by themselves.
